english.title: Trader engage in unfair commercial practice involving misleading action
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a trader, engaged in an unfair commercial practice likely to cause the average consumer to take a transactional decision that the consumer would not have taken otherwise as a result of the practice which involved a misleading action in that

(A)_[the provision of false or misleading information relating to a product, a trader or another matter relevant to a transactional decision,]_
(B)_[an overall presentation which was likely to deceive the average consumer about a matter relating to a product, a trader or another matter relevant to a transactional decision,]_
(C)_[marketing of a product which created confusion, or was likely to create confusion, with a product, trade mark, trade name or other distinguishing mark of another trader,]_

in that **(..SPECIFY BREACH..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 237(1) and 240 of the Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a trader
in breach of s 225(1) of the Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024
engaged in an unfair commercial practice which involved misleading action involving
the provision of false/misleading information relating to a product/trader/other matter relevant to a transactional decision OR
an overall presentation which was likely to deceive the average consumer about a matter relating to a product/trader/other matter relevant to a transactional decision OR
marketing of a product which created confusion/was likely to create confusion with a product/trade mark/trade name/other distinguishing mark of another trader

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Reference to misleading information includes reference to information which, although true, is presented in a misleading way, see section 226(2) of the Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024.(ii) An overall presentation may be deceiving even if the information it contains is true (section 226(3)).
(iii) Reference to another trader in section 226(1)(c) is reference to a trader other than the trader supplying the product that is being marketed (section 226(4)).
(iv) Section 238 of the Act provides a defence of due diligence and innocent publication.
(v) See section 239 for the criminal liability of other persons where the commission of the offence, or what would have been an offence had it not been for a defence, is due to the act or omission of another person (see H101738), and also for corporate liability.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: a fine.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see section 241
